description: Every platform this server prices per sale is Etsy, Shopify Basic, Payhip Free, Plus and Pro, Gumroad direct and Discover, Ko-fi Shop, Notion Marketplace, and Square online or in person. It returns rates as fractions, fixed and listing fees in USD, monthly plan fee, whether it sells digital downloads, whether the seller adds their own processor, the tax-base flag, fees-as-of date, source URLs, and the card processor presets. Use it when you need valid platform ids or to read the sourced rates. Ko-fi Gold is a plan option, so it appears only in compare_plans. Do not use it for price or fee math (use the other tools), for sellers outside the US, for Amazon FBA, for competitor repricing, or for VAT. It takes no inputs. US sellers only. Read-only.
name: list_platforms
title: List platforms and fee presets
